purpose: Similar-game mechanics and selected player feedback for the Mota PC playability analysis
method: Developer-published store descriptions and publicly readable Steam Community review pages; purposive theme selection, not a representative survey

sources.supports: Handcrafted deterministic towers, undo/redo, status comparison, memos and replay progression
Selected individual opinions about sequencing, multiple solutions, undo and audience fit
Handcrafted deterministic encounters and resource/order optimization
Positive global optimization experience and negative loss of local completion/trial-and-error experience
Small dungeons, exploration-based recovery, replay from earlier state and character variety
Tower-of-the-Sorcerer influence, generated levels, item systems, difficulties and player maps
Sequencing, cleanup repetition, opaque prerequisites and cross-run comparison concerns
Telegraphed attacks, protecting buildings, equipment and mission variation
Individual reports of replay interest, chess-like planning and patience requirements

reviews.paraphrase_zh: 喜欢资源和行动顺序，但说明受众小众。
肯定多解和免费撤销，也提醒可能很快疲倦。
欣赏全局资源与行动顺序优化。
怀念单房间完成感，认为整体关卡容易变成试错。
喜欢策略深度与预测改进，但有界面和按键配置意见。
认为新表现和信息分散削弱全图战术识别。
认可确定性战斗顺序，也指出回来清怪的重复感。
批评隐晦前提、攻略依赖与跨局资源的成绩公平问题。
完成成就之后仍然想继续游玩。
喜欢棋式推演，说明耐心门槛与个人风险回报偏好。

limitations: Ten selected historical reviews are neither population sentiment nor proof that the same product issues remain in 2026.
Review collection URLs are live lists; locate samples by game, post date and theme. Individual permanent links were not verified for every sample.
Primarily English high-helpfulness Steam comments; hardcore-player, language and platform selection biases remain.
No sampled review sentiment frequencies, retention percentages, sales estimates or marketing playtime claims are used as outcome evidence.
Cross-game findings motivate hypotheses; they do not prove benefits in the current game.

excluded_or_unavailable.reason: Full fetch returned 403; used the developer-published Steam description instead.
Full fetch timed out; search snippets not counted as independent player evidence.
No verified complete discussion body was obtained for the selected Chinese search results; excluded from the main sample.
Direct machine-side request did not return usable JSON; not counted as a successful API sample.
